1781818586045.alias: Smoke Alarm — LED Matrix Alert On
1781818586045.description: Critical alert on the LED matrix sign while any smoke alarm is on. Repeats every 30s until they clear (max 2h). Names every detector that is on.

data.payload: {% set on = ["binary_sensor.avas_room_alarm_status", "binary_sensor.basement_alarm_status", "binary_sensor.dining_room_alarm_status", "binary_sensor.upstairs_hall_alarm_status", "binary_sensor.smoke_alarm_alarm_status"] | select("is_state","on") | map("state_attr","friendly_name") | map("replace"," Alarm Status","") | list %}{{ {"title":"FIRE ALARM","message":("SMOKE: " ~ (on | join(" + "))) if on else "SMOKE ALARM - CHECK THE HOUSE","severity":"critical","icon_name":"lametric:7756","ttl":60} | to_json }}

1781818617226.alias: Smoke Alarm — LED Matrix Alert Off
1781818617226.description: All clear on the LED matrix sign once every smoke alarm has gone from on to off (not on reconnects).

smoke_co_led_matrix_alert.description: Critical alert on the LED matrix sign when a CO sensor reads over 35 ppm for a minute. Repeats every 30s until all are 10 ppm or lower (max 2h), then posts an all clear.

data.payload: {% set ns = namespace(items=[]) %}{% for e in ["sensor.basement_carbon_monoxide", "sensor.dining_room_carbon_monoxide", "sensor.upstairs_hall_carbon_monoxide"] %}{% if states(e) | float(0) > 35 %}{% set ns.items = ns.items + [state_attr(e,"friendly_name") | replace(" CO Reading","") ~ " " ~ (states(e) | float(0) | round(0) | int) ~ " PPM"] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ {"title":"CARBON MONOXIDE","message":("CO: " ~ (ns.items | join(" + "))) if ns.items else "CO ALARM - CHECK THE HOUSE","severity":"critical","icon_name":"warning","ttl":60} | to_json }}

until.value_template: {{ ["sensor.basement_carbon_monoxide", "sensor.dining_room_carbon_monoxide", "sensor.upstairs_hall_carbon_monoxide"] | map("states") | map("float",0) | select(">",10) | list | count == 0 or repeat.index >= 240 }}
